reason: I would try it because I can run it on my own machine and leave AI off, which feels safer for my resume than uploading everything to an unknown service. I would still want a clear explanation of what job searches or connected providers can see before I use real application details.
objection: Self-hosting helps, but I do not know exactly where my profile and application data stays or what gets sent to a job source or AI provider.
would_change_my_mind: A short data-flow and privacy guide, plus a sample-data walkthrough before I enter my real resume.
